D.treatment: health sciences students in the Bangladesh sample
D.comparison: health sciences students in the Indian and Thai samples

cells.quote: The prevalence of IA among health sciences students varied considerably across studies, ranging from concerning to very high levels. In one sample, 84% of Bangladeshi medical students reported some degree of IA, indicating an epidemic within that educational setting. In contrast, other studies reported lower prevalences of approximately 6% among Indian dental students [15] and 24.4% among Thai medical students [26].
cells.note: This is a cross-study prevalence contrast, not a manipulated treatment comparison.
